subject: RHadoop: Using more mappers on large files

messages.author: 33032e7696718e46
messages.subject: RHadoop: Using more mappers on large files
parts:
I am trying to use RHadoop to run word count on a 50GB file. It works with 513 mappers and 142 reducers but takes 37 mins! I was trying to reduce the time by increasing the number of mappers to more than 1000, but it doesn't work. Any ideas why this is so?
Thanks!

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: RHadoop: Using more mappers on large files
parts:
Please look into the vectorized.reduce argument to mapreduce. That requires you to also write a vectorized reducer, that is a reducer that can process multiple reduce groups in one call (in this case, multiple words). Writing an efficient one can be tricky. If I were doing this, I would form a data frame with keys and values than use dplyr to aggregate it (functions group and summarise).


Antonio
